technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochastic recovery signal, but price remains below all short-term MAs, MACD is negative, and momentum indicators lack conviction—setup favors bounce traders only, not swing entries.

fundamental.summary: INCY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 5 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with imminent earnings binary event create elevated risk environment for INCY.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with stochastic bullish cross and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment create textbook bounce setup in fear-driven market (21/100 sentiment).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all short-term MAs with negative MACD, CMF, OBV, and PSAR; imminent earnings binary (5 days) + crisis VIX + zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward heavily unfavorable.
